correctness.rationale: For the exactly 979 normalized words across q=1,...,5, all 53130 ordered-index increasing five-column minors per word are decided by two split-prime reductions. Hadamard bounds each conjugate determinant by 5^(5/2), hence its nonzero integer cyclotomic norm by 5^20. Since 10000141*10000261=100004020036801>5^20, common vanishing mod both primes implies vanishing over C. The C++ code checks primality, exact root orders, tests the minors, and records 709 witnesses. A separate integer permutation determinant program checks the q=2 and q=5 extremes with phi_5. The five q totals and 5 binary normalized pattern list are exact finite statements; no claim beyond this bounded domain.
